SELECT album_info.id, base_category2.category1_id, base_category1.name as category1_name,
base_category3.category2_id, base_category2.name as category2_name,
album_info.category3_id, base_category3.name as category3_name FROM album_info INNER JOIN base_category3 ON album_info.category3_id = base_category3.id INNER JOIN base_category2 ON base_category3.category2_id = base_category2.id INNER JOIN base_category1 ON base_category2.category1_id = base_category1.id WHERE album_info.id = #{albumId} AND album_info.is_deleted = 0
